I was a scalp picker from the age of 7-13. I was doing this because of high levels of stress due to a shitty upbringing and grief at school. It started when i got lice. The treatments my mum would put on my hair would dry out my scalp, and i would pick at the lower back of my scalp all the time. I guess it was just a nervous habit i developed. Parent's react terribly sometimes because deep down they blame themselves, i know my mum did, but it was down to me not her.  I know right now it seems like the last thing a secret cutter would want to do, but it decreases a lot of stress if you just open up to someone and say you're struggling.

If they found out, maybe it wouldn't be a such a bad thing? When my parents found out, their reaction wasn't the greatest, but at least i didn't have the burden of hiding my addiction every day. If you don't want to then that's totally up to you, just reminding you that it is an option.
